assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production high-definition 360-degree equirectangular sky environment texture for a retro-futuristic first-person videogame, 2:1 aspect ratio, highest resolution. Reference image is ONLY a mood/lighting reference for its CLOUDS. Generate a NEW environment without any architecture. Camera floats miles above earth within an immense storm-cloud ocean. True equirectangular spherical panorama: horizontal covers 360 degrees, vertical covers zenith to nadir, horizon at middle height. Lower half and entire bottom: endless beautifully detailed soft white and pale slate cumulonimbus cloud sea, billowing rounded cloud tops, no land or water. Upper half: towering blue-grey storm clouds sweeping around the horizon, atmospheric cold blue openings and silver sunlight filtering at one side, immense sense of height, dramatic realistic cloud forms. Zenith clouded pale blue-grey, nadir luminous white-grey cloud blanket. Soft luminous horizon haze merges sky and lower clouds. Atmospheric painterly realism with exceptionally rich natural shapes and restrained contrast. Left/right panorama edges must join seamlessly; polar regions have continuous consistent color. Entire image consists solely of atmosphere and clouds. NO fortress, platforms, buildings, objects, airships, people, ground, mountains, text, watermark, black holes, cube borders, grids, frames or lightning painted into the texture (lightning will animate in-engine). It is a usable spherical environment, not a picture of a location.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable transparent cloud texture for realtime animated clouds in a high-altitude game. Generate one large square highly detailed cloud bank, viewed obliquely from above at about 60 degrees. A dense cluster of majestic rolling white and pale bluish-grey cumulus lobes, fine wispy vapour at the edges, soft translucent perimeter that fades fully into a transparent background on ALL FOUR edges with ample transparent margin. Gentle silver-white light from upper left, subtle cool shaded valleys give real three-dimensional thickness. Beautiful realistic detailed cloud forms, matching an endless white cloud sea beneath a retro-futuristic aerial arena. One coherent cloud bank fills about 85 percent width, approximately round overall silhouette, no hard rectangular edge, not a row of isolated little clouds. High definition square 2048x2048, rich texture. True RGBA transparency, not a checkerboard or solid backdrop. Clouds only: no sky, no ground, no lightning, no buildings, no text or watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: nadir skybox texture, square high definition 2048x2048. Reference image is cloud lighting and atmosphere ONLY. Camera looking perfectly straight DOWN from miles high onto an endless sea of storm-cloud tops, orthographic-like 90 degree field of view. Soft white, silver and pale blue-grey cumulus clouds filling every pixel, beautiful billowing rounded lobes and deep soft shaded valleys, rich natural texture, brightly luminous mist. Evenly distributed irregular clouds everywhere with NO focal point. Clouds lit gently from one side, large sense of real depth. IMPORTANT: this is a direct straight-down camera picture, NOT equirectangular, NOT a spherical panorama; no radial symmetry, no vortex, no flower/pinwheel pattern, no horizon, no converging lines, no perspective aimed toward horizon, no transparent background. No objects, no platforms, no mountains, no ground, no water, no text, no borders, no lightning. Match the natural realistic painted cloud forms in the reference without its upper sky.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: zenith skybox texture, square high-definition 2048x2048. Reference image provides cloud atmosphere/lighting ONLY. Camera looks perfectly straight UP into a majestic, very high storm-cloud ceiling with a little cold blue-grey sky opening between clouds. Direct 90 degree camera view upward, NOT equirectangular and NOT a spherical panorama. Cloud undersides are cool slate blue-grey and silver-grey, illuminated edges at one side, rich natural irregular cloud forms and soft vapour. Cloudy, dramatic but readable medium brightness, gentle atmospheric scattering. Random asymmetric arrangement, NO central focal point and no symmetry. Fill every pixel with sky or clouds. No radial symmetry, no flower/pinwheel, no circular vortex, no converging perspective. No horizon, architecture, platforms, objects, ground, people, lightning, text, borders or watermark.
